title: Astra TierTagger
description: A mod that display player tier in Minecraft
body:
# Astra TierTagger

**Astra TierTagger** is a client-side Minecraft mod designed to display player ranking tiers (**Astra**) dynamically in-game. It features deep integration with game visuals, advanced performance optimizations, and satisfying high-fidelity audio feedback.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ✨ **PREMIUM FEATURES**
----------------------------------------------------------------------
⚡ **AstraTier Nametags**
   Displays players' custom **Astra rankings** right above their heads with color-coded visual styling based on their actual tier level.

⚡ **Tab List Integration**
   Syncs rankings directly onto the server player list (**TAB**), allowing you to scan the lobby's top players at a single glance.

⚡ **Interactive Chat Tiers**
   Prefixes player tiers alongside their chat messages dynamically, rendering beautiful separators and formatted badges.

⚡ **Real-Time Target HUD**
   Hover your crosshair over any player to see a clean, minimalist **HUD popup** displaying their username, gamemodes, and current tier.

⚡ **TierFPSBoost** *(Performance Engine)*
   Utilizes an advanced custom rendering cache to prevent FPS drops. Components are formatted once and cached, ensuring **butter-smooth gameplay** even in packed lobbies or PvP fights.

⚡ **Dynamic Audio Feedback**
   Satisfying sound effects for all actions (**experience orb dings** for successful lookups, **note block plings** for community lookups, and **villager warnings** for lookup failures).

----------------------------------------------------------------------
  ⌨️ **INTERACTIVE COMMANDS**
----------------------------------------------------------------------
▶ `/tiertagger` *(or `/tier`, `/tt`)*
  Toggle the mod status on or off instantly.

▶ `/tiertagger toggle`
  Toggle formatting visibility in nametags, tab, and chat.

▶ `/tiertagger reload`
  Reload configurations and sync the local cache with the remote API to get the absolute latest player tiers.

▶ `/tiertagger check <player>`
  Perform a live check on any player to see their official **Astra** details and records across all PvP gamemodes.

▶ `/tiertagger discord`
  Join the community! Displays a fully clickable link with a hover tooltip to open our Discord server in your browser.
